config.score_scale: abs, rel and gap_prob use CrossEncoder sigmoid probabilities; gap_logit uses raw logits

rules.abs: keep ranks with probability >= tau; rank 1 always
rules.rel: keep ranks with probability >= rho * p1; rank 1 always
rules.gap_prob: cut after the first largest gap between adjacent top-five probabilities when that gap is > 0 and >= g; g = inf never cuts; a zero gap never cuts
rules.gap_logit: the gap_prob rule on raw logits

config.grouping: dataset tags joined by '/', else case:<id>
config.fold_rule: groups by descending size then name, each to the fold with the fewest cases
config.selection: max exact train precision (sum of per-case four-decimal values) s.t. train recall, FULL, MISS no worse than top_k_5; ties: more kept documents, then grid order

bootstrap.method: paired case bootstrap percentile 95%, linear quantiles

config.preregistered: grid, CV rule and verdict fixed on 2026-09-23 before any score was seen

in_sample_best.note: selected on all 100 cases; optimistic, not the headline

verdict.headline: 5-fold grouped cross-validation, held-out cases
verdict.scope: H-relative exploratory verdict on the phase-C harness, without parent-window expansion; not shipment approval: no cut of the control's top five can reach the review floor, and production expansion is not measured
verdict.note: SHIP_CANDIDATE is not a default change; production adoption is the owner's decision
